workload.description: S3(x1,x2,z) sanity case: asymptotic reach (box [0,2]^2) and finite JM lattices l = 1, 2 (dim 9, 25) on a3-fast-32bit-p256class (p = 4294967291, prime order n = 4294959973); also univariate and Boneh-Durfee known-bound reproduction

metric: asymptotic delta* and largest delta with all finite trials succeeding (>= 2 rows vanish over Z)
note: delta*(S3) = 1/6 (closure optimum = best box for l <= 12, 0.154789 at l = 12); finite 32-bit: l = 1 all trials to 0.10, l = 2 all trials to 0.12, matching repo probes B/C. Engine reproduces univariate l/(dl+d-1) (30/30) and Boneh-Durfee x+y lattice (0.28466 at l = 2000 vs 0.28475).
